cards.ex: He thought he could get away with cheating on the exam.
cards.exUz: U imtihonda aldash jazosidan qutulib keta olaman deb o'yladi.
cards.uzDef: Qilmishiga yarasha jazo olmaslik, qutulib ketish.

cards.ex: He had to serve time for robbery.
cards.exUz: U o'g'irlik uchun qamoqda o'tirishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqxonada jazo muddatini o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The suspect is finally behind bars.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi nihoyat panjara ortida.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda, ozodlikdan mahrum qilingan holda.

cards.ex: She's a law-abiding citizen with no criminal record.
cards.exUz: U hech qanday jinoyat o'tmishiga ega bo'lmagan qonunga itoatkor fuqaro.
cards.uzDef: Qonunlarga rioya qiluvchi, jinoyat qilmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: He learned the hard way that crime doesn't pay.
cards.exUz: U jinoyat foyda keltirmasligini qiyin yo'l bilan o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat bilan shug'ullanish oxir-oqibat foyda keltirmaydi.

cards.ex: The judge threw the book at him for his violent crimes.
cards.exUz: Sudya uning zo'ravonlik jinoyatlari uchun uni qattiq jazoladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qattiq jazolash, qonunning eng qattiq jazosini qo'llash.

cards.ex: He's on probation after his release from prison.
cards.exUz: U qamoqdan chiqqanidan keyin sinov muddatida.
cards.uzDef: Ozodlikda, lekin sud nazoratida bo'lish.

cards.ex: You can't take the law into your own hands.
cards.exUz: Siz qonunni o'z qo'lingizga ololmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni o'z qo'liga olish, qonuniy jarayonlarga murojaat qilmaslik.

cards.ex: He received a stiff sentence for drug trafficking.
cards.exUz: U giyohvand moddalar savdosi uchun qattiq hukm oldi.
cards.uzDef: Og'ir, qattiq jazo, uzoq muddatga qamoq jazosi.

cards.ex: The defendant decided to plead guilty.
cards.exUz: Ayblanuvchi aybini tan olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda o'z aybiga iqror bo'lish.

cards.ex: The prosecution must prove his guilt beyond a reasonable doubt.
cards.exUz: Prokuratura uning aybini hech qanday asosli shubha qoldirmaydigan darajada isbotlashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday asosli shubha qoldirmaydigan darajada isbotlash.

cards.ex: He was fined for a minor offense.
cards.exUz: U mayda jinoyat uchun jarimaga tortildi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, ahamiyatsiz huquqbuzarlik.

cards.ex: Having a criminal record can make it hard to find a job.
cards.exUz: Jinoyat o'tmishiga ega bo'lish ish topishni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning avval sodir etgan jinoyatlari haqidagi ma'lumotlar.

cards.ex: His family bailed him out of jail.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi uni garovga qo'yib qamoqdan chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir garov puli to'lab, qamoqdan chiqarish.

cards.ex: He was sentenced to five years in prison.
cards.exUz: U besh yilga qamoq jazosiga hukm qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Sud tomonidan kimnidir jazoga hukm qilish.

cards.ex: The company is under investigation for fraud.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya firibgarlik uchun tergov ostida.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda tekshirilayotgan, tergov qilinayotgan.

cards.ex: The evidence points to him as the prime suspect.
cards.exUz: Dalillar uni asosiy gumonlanuvchi sifatida ko'rsatmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Dalillar nimagadir ishora qilmoqda, nimadir ehtimol ekanligini ko'rsatmoqda.

cards.ex: He decided to turn himself in to the police.
cards.exUz: U politsiyaga o'z ixtiyori bilan taslim bo'lishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z ixtiyori bilan politsiyaga taslim bo'lish.

cards.ex: He'll have to face the music for his actions.
cards.exUz: U o'z harakatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolar uchun javobgarlikka tortilish, oqibatlarini ko'tarish.

cards.ex: The police dropped the charges due to lack of evidence.
cards.exUz: Politsiya dalillar yetishmasligi sababli ayblovni bekor qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ayblovni olib tashlash, davom ettirmaslik.

cards.ex: They booked him for drunk driving.
cards.exUz: Ular uni mast holda mashina haydagani uchun hibsga olishdi.
cards.uzDef: Politsiya tomonidan rasman hibsga olish.

cards.ex: He shouldn't be behind the wheel after drinking.
cards.exUz: U ichgandan keyin rulda bo'lmasligi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mashina haydash holatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: He tried to make amends for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U xatolari uchun zararni qoplashga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xato uchun tovon to'lash, zararni qoplash.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves their day in court.
cards.exUz: Har kim o'z ishini sudga taqdim etishga haqli.
cards.uzDef: O'z ishini sudga taqdim etish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: The prosecutor thought it was an open and shut case.
cards.exUz: Prokuror bu oson ish deb o'yladi.
cards.uzDef: Oson yechimga ega bo'lgan, aniq ish.

cards.ex: He decided to waive his rights and speak to the police.
cards.exUz: U o'z huquqlaridan voz kechishga va politsiya bilan gaplashishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z huquqlaridan ixtiyoriy ravishda voz kechish.

cards.ex: The suspect is still on the run.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi hali ham qochqinda.
cards.uzDef: Qonundan yashirinish, qochib yurish.

cards.ex: He pleaded the fifth to avoid incriminating himself.
cards.exUz: U o'ziga qarshi ko'rsatma berishdan qochish uchun sukut saqlash huquqidan foydalandi.
cards.uzDef: Konstitutsiyaning 5-moddasiga asosan sukut saqlash huquqidan foydalanish.

cards.ex: Critics say the government is too soft on crime.
cards.exUz: Tanqidchilar hukumatni jinoyatga nisbatan juda yumshoq deyishadi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatlarga nisbatan qattiq choralar ko'rmaslik.

cards.ex: Some people believe in harsh punishment for serious crimes.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar og'ir jinoyatlar uchun qattiq jazo tarafdori.
cards.uzDef: Juda og'ir, shafqatsiz jazo.
